title: FP&A Analyst
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**
**We’re Looking For People Who**

* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

**Job Description**
**Job Title - FP&A Analyst**
**Experience - 5–7 Years**
**Location - Hybrid**
**Role - Third Party Payrolls**
**Position Summary**
The FP&A Analyst will own budgeting, forecasting, actuals reporting and variance analysis for assigned Engineering, IT and non-engineering cost centers and projects. The role also supports month-end closing activities, headcount reporting, project finance (WBS, capitalization, Workday Projects) and ad-hoc / scenario-based analysis for India leadership (SMT), Engineering Directors and global finance teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented and comfortable working in Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP and advanced Excel to deliver accurate, timely and well-explained numbers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Budgeting & Forecasting**
Prepare annual budgets and monthly forecasts for assigned cost centers and projects; load them into the planning system; run scenario analysis.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Analyze actuals vs budget, prior forecast and prior year (monthly and YTD), with bridges and clear commentary.
  
  
**Headcount Reporting**
Consolidate and report headcount; align with approved positions and budget; reconcile to cost centers.
  
  
**Month-End Close**
Support month-end close, including journal entries, accruals and reconciliations, in coordination with the accounting team.
  
  
**Project Finance & Capitalization**
Set up WBS projects in SAP; monitor AUCs and quarterly releases to Fixed Assets; run amortization simulations; support Workday Projects (budget setup, resource and project loading, labor-rate tie-outs); reconcile Workday Projects to SAP; support mid-year project labor absorption and cap rates; maintain the Plan of Record (POR) repository for NPD/NFD projects.
  
  
**Reporting & Ad-hoc Analysis**
Prepare management reporting packages and dashboards; deliver ad-hoc and business case analysis for leadership.
  
  
**Controls & Documentation**
Keep reconciliations and audit support current; maintain process documentation.
  
  
**RECURRING DELIVERABLES**
**Month-end close & journals**
Accurate, on-time close support
  
  
**Actuals & variance reporting**
Variances vs budget, prior forecast, prior year
  
  
**Forecast & headcount reporting**
Forecast load and headcount reconciliation/ reporting BU wise
  
  
**Project reporting & reconciliations**
Project actuals, variances, bridges; Workday Projects-to-SAP reconciliations and tie-outs; WD Project Systems forecast
  
  
**WBS project set-up & AUC monitoring**
SAP WBS set-up; AUC monitoring and releases to Fixed Assets
  
  
**Budget preparation & scenarios**
Annual budget load and scenario analysis
  
  
**Experience**
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
5–7 years in FP&A, business finance or financial analysis, ideally in a corporate / captive / GCC environment with budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis ownership
  
  
**Must have**
**Education**
Bachelor's in Commerce, Finance or Accounting; MBA, CA, CMA or CFA preferred
  
  
**Excel & modeling**
Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, SUMIFS, multi-tab models); strong variance, bridge and scenario modeling skills
  
  
**Planning tools**
Hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar EPM tool) for forecast and budget loads
  
  
**ERP / finance systems**
Working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO, WBS / project systems, fixed assets); exposure to month-end close and journal entries
  
  
**Communication**
Explains variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders
  
  
**BI / dashboards**
Power BI or Tableau
  
  
**Good to have**
**Headcount & cost center analysis**
Experience with HC planning, reporting and reconciliation
  
  
**Workday Projects**
Experience with Workday Projects set-up and reconciliation
  
  
**Capitalization & amortization**
Familiarity with AUC, capitalization and amortization simulations
  
  
**BI / dashboards**
Power BI or Tableau for dashboards and reporting
  
  
**Communication**
Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain variances to non-finance leaders and global teams
  
  
**Working style**
Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, self-starter, comfortable with multiple recurring cycles and ad-hoc requests
  
  
**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Accurate, on-time close, forecast and budget deliverables.
* Clear variance commentary and clean reconciliations.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and audit readiness.

**About Pitney Bowes**
Pitney Bowes (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com.
  
  
**We Will**

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally (PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs)

Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.
  
  
All interested individuals must apply online.

title: Video Editor 2D
description:
**Role:**
Multimedia Video Creator & Animator

**Location:**
Uttar Pradesh (Hapur), India

**Work Arrangement:**
On-site

**Salary:**
Depending on experience, negotiable

**Contract:**
Full-time, permanent

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy working across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

As we continue to strengthen our digital presence and expand our marketing initiatives, we are looking for a versatile and commercially minded Multimedia Video Creator & Animator who can take content from idea to final delivery. The role requires strong capability across video editing, 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics, sound, voiceovers and multilingual content production for digital platforms, campaigns and corporate communications.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for planning, creating and delivering compelling video content that builds visibility, communicates and create awareness campaigns aligning with our expertise clearly.

Working closely with the marketing and business teams, you will turn briefs, scripts and ideas into polished content for social media, websites, digital campaigns, presentations and client-facing communications. You will be expected to select the right creative format, live action, edited footage, 2D animation, 3D animation, motion graphics or a blended approach to suit the audience and objective.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end creative role for someone who combines visual storytelling with sound judgement, technical versatility and an understanding of how content can generate awareness, engagement and qualified client interest across different markets and languages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end video production process, from concept development, scripting and storyboarding through editing, animation, sound and final delivery.
* Create high-quality short-form and long-form content for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, websites, digital campaigns, presentations and other relevant channels.
* Produce a varied mix of promotional videos, explainers, service-led content, thought-leadership videos, social reels, corporate films and campaign assets.
* Create 2D and 3D animations, motion graphics, animated typography, infographics and visual effects that make complex subjects clear and engaging.
* Edit raw footage into polished, well-paced videos with strong openings, clear narratives and effective calls to action.
* Record, source, generate or integrate professional voiceovers in English, Hindi and, where required, other languages.
* Add and refine music, sound effects, dialogue, audio enhancement, subtitles, captions, titles and transitions.
* Adapt scripts, on-screen text, subtitles and voiceovers for multilingual and region-specific audiences while maintaining meaning, tone and brand consistency.
* Translate business objectives and campaign briefs into creative video concepts designed to improve awareness, audience engagement and client enquiries.
* Work with subject-matter experts and marketing colleagues to simplify technical services and regulatory topics into accessible visual stories.
* Develop platform-specific versions, including suitable aspect ratios, lengths, hooks, captions and export settings.
* Apply colour correction, colour grading, compositing and finishing techniques to achieve a professional and consistent visual standard.
* Create reusable templates, animation systems and branded assets to improve production speed and consistency.
* Use audience response and content performance insights to refine formats, creative approaches and future video ideas.
* Manage multiple projects, feedback rounds, source files, project assets and final exports accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain quality control for factual accuracy, language, sound, branding and technical output before publication.
* Stay current with video, animation, AI-assisted production, voice and digital content trends, and recommend practical new approaches.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a resourceful, organised and technically strong video creator who can work confidently across editing, 2D and 3D animation, motion design, audio and voice-led content. You should have a strong creative eye and understand how to make professional content that holds attention and supports commercial objectives.

You should be able to take ownership from brief to final output, choose an effective production approach, work independently and collaborate constructively in a fast-paced environment. Strong spoken and written English and Hindi are valuable for this role; additional language capability is an advantage.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Demonstrable experience in end-to-end video production, multimedia content creation, animation or a related field.
* A strong portfolio or showreel covering a range of formats such as social content, promotional videos, explainers, motion graphics or animation.
* Advanced proficiency in professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro.
* Practical capability in 2D animation and motion graphics using tools such as Adobe After Effects or equivalent software.
* Working capability in 3D content creation or animation using Blender, Cinema 4D, Autodesk Maya or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of storytelling, scripting, storyboarding, pacing, composition and audience retention.
* Experience creating videos for social media, websites and digital marketing campaigns.
* Sound knowledge of audio editing, sound design, music synchronisation, voiceover integration and dialogue enhancement.
* Ability to create accurate titles, subtitles and captions, including multilingual versions.
* Good command of spoken and written English and Hindi.
* Understanding of colour correction, colour grading, compositing and professional finishing.
* Knowledge of video formats, resolutions, aspect ratios, compression and platform-specific export settings.
* Ability to interpret business and campaign briefs, contribute creative ideas and follow brand guidelines.
* Strong attention to detail, factual accuracy, quality control and file organisation.
* Ability to manage several projects, respond constructively to feedback and meet deadlines.
* Clear communication and effective collaboration skills.

**Desirable Experience**

* Fluency in English, one or more additional Indian or international languages.
* Experience localising video content for different countries, cultures or audience segments.
* Experience in creating lead-generation, brand awareness or conversion-focused video campaigns.
* Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or similar graphic design tools.
* Experience with AI-assisted tools for video generation, animation, voice, transcription, translation or production workflows.
* Experience presenting technical, professional services or regulated-industry topics in a clear and engaging way.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Established a distinctive and professional video style aligned with GCRS branding.
* Built a reliable end-to-end production workflow covering editing, animation, audio, voiceovers and multilingual delivery.
* Produced a consistent mix of high-quality content for the company’s priority digital platforms and campaigns.
* Created clear, engaging videos that strengthen awareness of GCRS services and contribute to audience growth and client interest.
* Delivered effective 2D, 3D and motion-led explainers for complex services and technical subjects.
* Developed reusable templates, animation assets and production systems that improve speed and consistency.
* Collaborated effectively with marketing, business and subject-matter teams while meeting agreed deadlines.
* Used audience and campaign insights to improve creative formats, messaging and performance over time.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join an international business and contribute to its growing digital marketing and brand communication initiatives.

You will have the opportunity to work on diverse creative projects, experiment with new editing techniques and AI-powered tools and help shape how GCRS communicates its expertise and services through video content.

The role offers scope to broaden your portfolio across editing, 2D and 3D animation, motion design, multilingual production and creative campaign development, with opportunities to progress into a senior multimedia creator, animation lead or creative content production role as the business expands.

**Important:**
This is a preferred on-site role based at one of our offices in Uttar Pradesh (Hapur). Candidates must be willing to be in the office during the week when needed.

**To apply,**
please submit your CV through LinkedIn with a short covering note highlighting your experience across video creation, editing, animation, audio, voiceovers and multilingual content. Please include a portfolio or showreel that clearly demonstrates your strongest 2D, 3D, motion graphics, social, promotional or explainer work.

title: Career Counsellor | Meerut
description:
**Company Description** 
 iDreamCareer (iDC) is India’s most trusted career guidance brand, working with leading education boards, private schools, and government institutions to empower students in making informed career choices. As the Technical Partner to CBSE and the first career guidance company to feature on Shark Tank India, iDC has a strong track record of innovation and impact. Its AI\-powered platforms, including BlueSpring for private schools and PathShila for government schools, support millions of students through structured guidance programs. Powered by iDC ONE, India’s advanced career guidance AI, iDC collaborates with a large network of independent career counsellors, companies, and institutions. The iDC Council, with over 5,550 active certified counsellors trained in partnership with Boston University’s Wheelock College, reflects iDC’s commitment to building a world where every child can pursue a joyful and meaningful career.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 \-
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Contractual (Full Time)
 



**Contract Duration:** 
 till Jan 2027
 



**Locations:** 
 Meerut, UP
 



  





**Role Summary** 





 The Counsellor will support career guidance and student engagement initiatives by coordinating with schools, conducting AI Career Awareness sessions, maintaining data records, and managing assigned assets. This is a field\-based role that requires daily travel to schools and educational institutions within the assigned city.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. School Coordination** 



* Coordinate regularly with school authorities, teachers, and designated school contacts.
* Schedule and manage AI Career Awareness sessions.
* Ensure smooth communication between the organization and partner schools.
* Support the planning and execution of school\-based activities and events.



**2\. AI Career Awareness Sessions** 



* Conduct AI Career Awareness sessions using the organization's portal, videos, and learning resources.
* Guide students on emerging career opportunities, future skills, and technology trends.
* Facilitate student participation and address basic queries during sessions.
* Ensure proper setup and operation of audiovisual equipment during presentations.



**3\. Data Management \& MIS Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate daily records of activities, school visits, and student participation.
* Update MIS reports and databases on a regular basis.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and documentation.
* Track program outcomes and maintain relevant records.



**4\. Asset Management** 



* Manage and maintain assigned assets responsibly.
* Ensure proper usage, safety, and upkeep of equipment.
* Report any damage, loss, or maintenance requirements promptly.
* Maintain records of asset allocation and utilization.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Graduate or pursuing Graduation in any discipline.
* Willingness to work in the field on a daily basis.
* Open to travelling extensively within the city for school visits and program implementation.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable operating audiovisual equipment such as projectors, speakers, microphones, TVs, and displays.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to coordinate effectively with schools and manage multiple tasks.
* Strong organizational, reporting, and documentation skills.



**Preferred Attributes** 



* Interest in education, career counselling, and emerging technologies.
* Ability to engage and interact confidently with students.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and responsible attitude.
* Ability to work independently and meet assigned targets.



**Key Requirement** 





 This is primarily a field\-based role. The selected candidate will be required to travel daily within the assigned city, visit schools, conduct awareness sessions, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure smooth execution of program activities.
 




  





**Reporting To** 




  





**Program Coordinator / Project Manager**
